reviews.text: I am so grateful for your repeated visits to my chick during emergencies. Although you are not a bird specialist, you were the only one who treated my child when everywhere else refused. If it were a little closer to my house, I would even ask you to treat my cat. The hospital is cute both inside and out, and even the medicine bags are adorable. Thank you always.
My budgie was sick before and I had him examine her before, but he's a really good doctor and I'm very grateful. This time too, the budgie is recovering smoothly.
A stylish animal hospital. My budgie wasn't feeling well, so I took him in for an examination, and the doctor was very kind and patiently explained how to administer the medicine.

It was my first visit. I went in for a cat flu.
First of all, I was annoyed by the way the receptionist spoke on the phone. After that, I was able to make an appointment, but the doctor still turned his back on me when I lifted my cat onto the examination table. The receptionist and I worked together to take the cat's temperature and weight. The doctor still turned his back on me and wouldn't even look at me. At this point, I decided not to come back.
I was given some medicine, but I will never go back.
I think the first thing to do is greet the doctor. You may be examining animals, but I think communication with owners is also important. I was left with nothing but dissatisfaction.

I took my budgie to the doctor on Sunday. I suspected she had an egg blockage, so I took her in. They gave her some nutritional supplements to help her regain her strength and because they suspected she was lacking vitamins, so I'll keep an eye on her. The next day she recovered and successfully laid an egg. She licked the medicine with gusto, making a popping noise (?).
